decisions.reason: As a very recent launch with its own product page, this low-pile decorative carpet has visible commitment behind it, so management is likely to give it more time despite carpets being somewhat peripheral to core furniture manufacturing.

The hand-knotted wool silk carpet looks like a higher-investment premium item and was publicly presented on its own page, which under an escalation-of-commitment logic makes withdrawal within only a year less likely.

This product benefits from the same recent public commitment as the other launches, but because it is another low-pile decorative carpet in a crowded adjacent category its risk of being culled is somewhat higher.

A corner bench sits close to the firm’s core furniture business, and the recent dedicated presentation increases the chance that management continues backing it rather than admitting an early reversal.

Although a low-pile carpet is less central than furniture and may overlap with the other carpet launches, the firm has only recently invested in and publicly committed to it, which still favors retention for now.
The swivel shell chair is highly consistent with the company’s established furniture activity, and a recent standalone launch makes management especially inclined to keep supporting it.
